args.summary:
Modelled an 8×30 m continuous precast T-girder bridge (12.5 m deck, 5 girders per span, C50) as a 2D spine-beam OpenSeesPy model.

Key decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d; system: continuous (precast girders made continuous, no pier column geometry given → rigid supports at bearing lines).
- Girder: T-girder midspan section integrated → A=0.862 m², I=0.445 m⁴ per girder; ×5 girders → A=4.31 m², I=2.225 m⁴; Ec=34500 MPa (C50), γ=26.0 kN/m³; w=112.06 kN/m, m=11.423 t/m (self-weight of girders only).
- Bearings (5 per line, one under each girder end): supports 0–3 and 6–8 = PTFE sliding (longitudinally free, Kh=0); supports 4–5 = plain laminated elastomeric fixed (longitudinal spring). All laminated bearings: 300×400 mm, 5×8 mm layers → S=10.714, Kv=7098.3 MN/m, Kh=15000 kN/m.
- Live load: Class I, one-way, 3 lanes → qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320 kN per span, ξ=0.78. Modal analysis gave f1=4.52 Hz → μ=0.2508.

generate_model succeeded: all L1/L2/L3 checks passed. Max live-load positive moment 8356 kNm (end spans), max negative moment −6145 kNm; support reactions and dead-load moments are within expected ranges.
